checkpoint: MT-2.5 - Sales, invoices and returns migration

implemented: atomic outlet-authorized POS sale and invoice authority
explicit operational customer selection or creation without contact-based account merge
server-owned exact price, cost, document identity and immutable invoice/line snapshots
deterministic exact discount allocation with MT-2.8 monetary adjustment reference
bounded accepted returns with immutable compensating financial evidence
sellable, damaged and quarantined stock dispositions
forward serialized successor lineage and sellable-only active IMEI re-entry
strict offline synthetic POS invoice and sale import with replay/quarantine
real independent-connection arbitration of the last returnable quantity
excluded: public or internal sales/return routes and user interfaces
payment collection, refund execution, cash-session or provider effects
private source-data import, cutover or production action

verified_contracts: invoice gross equals the sum of persisted server price times quantity
invoice final equals gross minus exact discount and line allocations reconcile exactly
sale, adjustment, stock, IMEI, audit and idempotency evidence share one transaction
original invoices and sales are immutable when returns are accepted
cumulative accepted quantities never exceed the original sale
actual payment refunds are not created by MT-2.5
serialized return creates a new forward occurrence and retains the sold origin
active IMEI claim exists only for an eligible sellable occurrence
identical import replay is stable and changed/unresolved/invalid rows quarantine
Website/customer identity is never inferred from invoice contact snapshots
corrections_during_verification: The first rollback rehearsal exposed MySQL check constraints that had to be dropped before their columns. The down migration was corrected, the disposable test schema was rebuilt, and rollback/reapply plus schema verification passed.

The first full regression exposed pre-MT-2.5 synthetic direct-sale fixtures that omitted newly required sale identity and reconciled totals. The fixtures were updated to the new schema contract and affected plus full suites passed.
A signed decimal decoder was narrowed to the historical sales.profit destination so other imported money remains non-negative. Product, stock and sales migration suites passed after the correction.
